donationSettings.title: Building the Dream: 1910 Whispering Pines Manor Restoration
donationSettings.tagline: An authentic ground-up restoration of an iconic 116-year-old Craftsman & Victorian estate and community heritage B&B.
donationSettings.story: Whispering Pines was commissioned in 1910 by timber baron Thaddeus Vance using virgin old-growth Douglas fir and quarter-sawn white oak timbers. We are undertaking an authentic, ground-up restoration—jacking the 60-ton structure on hydraulic towers, restoring scalloped Peach Bottom black slate 32 feet high, replacing legacy lead supply pipes with modern PEX-A lines, and creating an educational craftsmanship center and community B&B. Every contribution directly funds historic materials, specialized restoration tools, and structural preservation.

startingPointNarratives.header: The Discovery: October Morning Initial Walkthrough
startingPointNarratives.subheader: Assessing 116 Years of Unchecked Weather & Settling
startingPointNarratives.paragraph: When we first unlocked the warped solid fir front door, dust motes hung in the cold morning light. The central timber carrier beam had sagged 3.5 inches toward the hearth, pulling interior plaster off the lath. Yet behind the crumbling wallpaper stood pristine old-growth white pine framing and intact heart-pine joists ready for revitalization.
startingPointNarratives.notes: Laser transit survey confirms center foundation settled 3.5"; no active termites detected; dry rot localized to north exterior sill plate.
startingPointNarratives.footnotes: Survey conducted October 12; archival blueprint matched to 1910 county tax assessment registry #4418.

startingPointPosts.title: Fieldstone Foundation & Center Timber Beam Sag
startingPointPosts.subtitle: Critical Structural Forensic Assessment
startingPointPosts.paragraph: The unreinforced dry-stack fieldstone crawlspace is carrying an estimated 60-ton dead load. Three timber uprights have tilted 4 degrees. Calibration screw-jacks must be installed before any 2nd-floor framing commences.
startingPointPosts.notes: Temporary 20-ton bottle jacks staged at pier 3. Moisture content in timber measures 18%.
startingPointPosts.footnotes: Structural engineering approval required before raising beam beyond 1/8 inch per 24-hour cycle.

photos.caption: Original elevation pencil survey marking foundation trench.

startingPointPosts.title: Grand Salon Hardwoods & Fireplace Mantle
startingPointPosts.subtitle: Historic Millwork & Floor Joist Deflection
startingPointPosts.paragraph: Quarter-sawn red oak flooring has buckled near the chimney stack due to historic hearth settling. The hand-carved mahogany fireplace mantle remains remarkably intact, though coated in five layers of lead varnish.
startingPointPosts.notes: Carefully number and remove floorboards with cat's paw prybars. Store in wood corral.
startingPointPosts.footnotes: Original 1910 iron damper intact; chimney flue requires steel liner before first test burn.
